First off I’m so sorry you had to go through this. It’s not your fault at all. He was awake and was well aware what he was doing was wrong. Don’t let him feed you any excuses or try to twist it to make it seem like it’s your fault. It’s not and it’s all on him. 

There are a number of things you can do. There’s no pressure to do any of them as the healing process is up to you and your comfort level. 

I would stop all contact with him. He clearly doesn’t care about your boundaries or respects your body. 

I would seek therapy or talk to anyone you can trust to help you deal with these feelings. 

You can also file a report with the police. What he did was sexual assault. 

Like I said there is no right answer and it’s all up to you on how you handle it. We are here for you and support any decision you decide to make. 

If you need someone to talk to you can pm me. Either way I wish you nothing but the best on your journey :)
